args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The file src/export/csv.ts shows that the BOM is set by default when writing CSV exports by the function writeCsv. The BOM is deliberately prefixed to aid spreadsheet apps in detecting UTF-8 encoding, explaining the client's observation. This file is the main place responsible for BOM behavior in exports, so any change or confirmation about keeping the BOM would be made here.
